𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗱 | 𝗪𝗲𝗯 𝗔𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝗗𝗶𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗿𝘂𝗶𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲

The Indian Netizens invites applications for its 𝗪𝗲𝗯 𝗔𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝗗𝗶𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻, providing an opportunity for motivated students and young professionals to contribute to research and public discourse on International Relations, Geopolitics, Public Policy, National Security, and Defence.

The 𝗪𝗲𝗯 𝗔𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝗗𝗶𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻 is responsible for producing well-researched, evidence-based, and impactful articles that aim to promote informed discussions on contemporary national and international issues. Selected candidates will work closely with the editorial team to research, write, edit, and publish original content while developing valuable skills in policy research, analytical writing, editorial review, and digital publishing.

We are currently recruiting for the following positions:

𝗪𝗲𝗯 𝗔𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝗗𝗶𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻
• Content Writers
• Editors
• Graphic Designers

𝗘𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽
• Managing Editor (1)
• Associate Editor (1)
• Assistant Editor (2)

𝗦𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗘𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀
• International Affairs & Geopolitics (2)
• National Security (2)

𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗗𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘀
• 𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗲: Remote
• 𝗗𝘂𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: 6 Months
• 𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗹𝘆 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗶𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: 12 to 18 Hours
• 𝗡𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲: Pro Bono (Unpaid)

𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗺:
https://lnkd.in/gExjp8Wf
𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗗𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲:
31 July 2026

Applicants should possess a keen interest in policy, governance, strategic affairs, and contemporary global developments, along with a willingness to learn, collaborate, and contribute consistently throughout the programme.

We encourage universities, academic institutions, faculty members, and our professional network to share this opportunity with students, researchers, and young professionals who may be interested in contributing to meaningful policy discourse.

Aditya Chaudhary | Bhaskar Jha | Arunanshu Sarkar | Jharna Singh | Priya Pandey | MADHURJYA PRATIM SARMAH | NILANJAN JHA | Soumya Vartika
